notes: The Label is the accessible name — keep it as real text (not an image) so screen readers announce the product. WCAG 1.1.1 / 4.1.2.
Decorative app icons: if the Label already names the product, mark the app icon aria-hidden so it isn't announced twice. WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content.
When the lockup is a link or nav item, make the whole unit one focusable target with a clear name — not separate tab stops for icon and text. WCAG 2.4.4 Link Purpose.
Contrast, especially knockout / inverse on media: keep the label and icons at 4.5:1 (text) / 3:1 (UI) against the surface; add a scrim on imagery. WCAG 1.4.3 / 1.4.11.
Order: the app icon precedes the label in the DOM so it reads in a logical sequence. WCAG 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence.

decisions.question: The archetype read as "none", which has no template in the dictionary (it has: link-card, card, collection, button, checkbox / radio, toggle / switch, input / field, badge / tag / chip, pagination, accordion, select / dropdown, helper text, list). Without one the draft gets no HTML element, no accessibility floor and no base CSS — the root falls back to <div>. Which archetype is this, really?
decisions.chose: drafted with no archetype floor; root element defaults to div
decisions.fix: Set "archetype" in the defs to one the dictionary templates, or re-scaffold with --archetype=<name>. If none fit, the dictionary needs a new entry.
decisions.evidence: no signal identified a kind — decide it rather than inheriting a default

decisions.question: Scaffolded as none (no signal identified a kind — decide it rather than inheriting a default). Confirm, or re-run npm run specs:scaffold -- --slug=product-lockup --archetype=<link-card|card|collection>.
decisions.chose: none — no signal identified a kind — decide it rather than inheriting a default
alternatives: link-card: A card that is one link: illustration or icon, a headline, optional description, an arrow affordance. The whole surface is the target and the headline is the accessible name.
card: A non-interactive content card; actions live in a slot.
collection: A row, grid or scroller of one repeated unit.
button: Triggers an action. A label, optional leading and trailing icons, and the full interactive state set.
checkbox / radio: A selection control with a checked state, usually paired with a label.
toggle / switch: A binary on/off control that applies immediately.
input / field: Accepts typed input. Label, value, placeholder, and an error state.
badge / tag / chip: A small label. Non-interactive unless it is dismissible.
pagination: Moves between pages of content.
accordion: A disclosure: a trigger that shows and hides a region of content. Open or closed is a prop a consumer sets, not an interaction state.
select / dropdown: A choice among options. The native <select> does the choosing; the design styles the trigger around it.
helper text: Guidance or a message under a field: hint, error, success. Associated with its field, never floating.
list: A sequence of like items — features, links, steps. The items are the content; the list is the rhythm.
decisions.evidence: decided by heuristic; token namespaces content×4, gray×1; state axis none

decisions.question: frame-1, app-icon, app-icon-2, s2a-icon-chevron-right have no class of their own in product-lockup.css. The design names these parts separately and the code does not. Split the class, or model them as one part.
decisions.chose: kept a derived selector that matches nothing
decisions.fix: Set anatomy.root.parts.<part>.selector to the real class, or add the class to product-lockup.css.

decisions.question: Structural match says extend: closest existing contract is Collapsible (score 1). Extend it instead of adding a component?
decisions.chose: a new component, over extending Collapsible (match extend, score 1)
decisions.fix: If it is the same component, delete this draft and add a variant to Collapsible instead.
decisions.evidence: Collapsible (1) already covers this; extend it.

decisions.question: productName, app, secondApp, showSecondIcon, styleVariant, showIconStart, showIcon, iconSize, caret exist in the component but have no design counterpart. Confirm each is authored (lever true) or integration-only (lever false).
decisions.chose: added 9 code-only props as levers with no design binding
decisions.fix: Set lever:false on the integration-only ones, or delete any the component should stop accepting.

decisions.question: Built from 1 component set, all of which already have a contract: AppIcon ×32. Confirm the anatomy models them as slots or parts deliberately.
decisions.chose: recorded 1 composed set, 1 already contracted; 1 icon set left for the icon slot
decisions.decision: All composed sets are contracted; anatomy models them deliberately.

Bind them to S2A tokens in Figma, or record a raw: exception with the reason.

decisions.question: 42 layers carry Figma-generated names (/Frame 1, /Frame 1/.icons/AppIcon/B_app_CreativeCloud/tile/colors/Ellipse 11, /Frame 1/.icons/AppIcon/B_app_CreativeCloud/tile/colors/Ellipse 14, /Frame 1/.icons/AppIcon/B_app_CreativeCloud/tile/colors/Ellipse 6, /Frame 1/.icons/AppIcon/B_app_CreativeCloud/tile/colors/Ellipse 8, …). Build set from this contract produces the normalized set (.root, .part names); replace the frame with it once reviewed.
decisions.fix: Run Build set from this contract, then re-anchor anchors.figma.nodeId to the normalized set.

decisions.question: 3 values in the design are set with no variable behind them: root/frame-1/icons gap@orientation=horizontal = 2px; root/s2a-icon-chevron-right width@orientation=horizontal = 8px; root/s2a-icon-chevron-right height@orientation=horizontal = 8px. A literal in a contract is a token gap: bind the property to an S2A variable in Figma and re-extract, or keep the raw: value and record why here.
decisions.chose: carried them through as raw: values so the render matches the file
decisions.fix: In Figma, bind the layer's property to an S2A variable, then re-extract; or replace the raw: with a {s2a.…} token that resolves to the same value.

decisions.question: The design binds s2a/product-lockup/gap-inline and the built token CSS does not ship it. Carry the literal until it does?
decisions.chose: {s2a.product-lockup.gap-inline} → raw:16px, the value the design resolves to. A token-pipeline gap: when s2a/product-lockup/gap-inline ships, replace the literal with {s2a.product-lockup.gap-inline}.
